about.label: About
about.title: Who I am
paragraphs: I'm Mohit. One year in, here's what I shipped.
An LLM gateway that replaced OpenRouter, cutting its 5% markup.
A terminal tool 500+ developers open daily.
A live auction SaaS I built alone.
9.45 CGPA taught me less than shipping did.

work.label: Where I got things done
work.title: Selected work
work.intro: Things I have built and shipped end to end. Products I run, client work, web and mobile apps, AI, VR and command-line tools.

projects.title: AuctionXI
projects.description: Live player auctions for any sport. Real-time bidding, broadcast-quality graphics and instant YouTube overlays, with no production team needed.
features: Every bid lands on every screen at once and the money always adds up.
Twenty ready-made broadcast scenes for the projector and the live stream.
Auction-ready in under 20 minutes, with every result ready to download after.

projects.title: TexAgent
projects.description: A digital bahi-khata for textile brokers. Bills, brokerage and follow-ups all in one place, instead of a paper book.
features: Every bill's GST and brokerage worked out automatically, exact to the paisa.
See who owes what and for how long, with follow-ups ready to go.
Each party's full account on one page, always up to date.

projects.title: Cache Karo
projects.description: A cross-platform command-line tool to analyze disk usage, hunt down cache hogs and reclaim space on macOS, Linux and Windows.
features: Install in one line with `pip install cachekaro`, published on PyPI.
Analyze disk usage and surface the biggest cache hogs.
Safe cleanup to free up space across macOS, Linux and Windows.

media.notes: Animated terminal replay: pip install → cachekaro analyze (ASCII banner, platform macOS, scans Chrome/Deno/Python/Go/Spotify/npm/uv/Homebrew caches, Total 4.40 GB, Cleanable 4.20 GB, top: Chrome 1.14 GB, uv 1.01 GB, npm 929.46 MB, Spotify 324.99 MB) → cachekaro clean --dry-run (101 items, would free 4.20 GB). Prompt: mohit@macbook ~ %. Version cachekaro-2.3.4.

projects.title: Aether
projects.description: An AI assistant that pulls real-time news, YouTube and Reddit into one conversational feed with 17+ response tones. Behind the chat sits a full NLP pipeline that scores every article before you ever see it.
features: Aggregates live news, YouTube videos and Reddit discussions.
17+ response tones plus a general-purpose assistant mode.
spaCy preprocessing feeds TF-IDF and k-means to group articles by keyword relevance, and an intent classifier picks what fits each query. Parallel fetching cut response time by 66%.
projects.liveNote: Free-tier demo, the first load can take a minute

projects.title: FlowLedger
projects.description: A cross-platform personal finance app built with Flutter. Track every income stream and expense, scan receipts and catch money leaks, all local-first with optional encrypted cloud sync.
features: Receipt scanning with Google ML Kit OCR and 53+ bank accounts.
Budgets, savings goals and AI money-leak detection.
Local-first storage with biometric lock and 12+ languages.

projects.title: Space Shuttle VR
projects.description: A room-scale VR game for Meta Quest. Complete hands-on tasks aboard a space shuttle and pilot it to the final portal.
features: Grab, dismantle and interact with objects using the XR Interaction Toolkit.
Task-based progression ending in a drivable shuttle sequence.
AI voice guidance built in Unity with ElevenLabs.

media.alt: Space Shuttle VR gameplay: the shuttle interior, a target range and the ladder climb

projects.title: VeloType
projects.description: A fast, minimal typing-speed test inspired by MonkeyType, built for feel, with themes, modes and real-time analytics.
features: 9 themes, 6 test modes and 12 languages, plus 16 code languages.
Smooth animated caret with real-time WPM analytics.
Built with React, Vite and Tailwind CSS.

projects.title: Windmill VR
projects.description: A calming VR breathing app for Meta Quest, with an animated 3D windmill paced to a 4-phase breathing cycle for guided mindfulness.
features: Animated 3D windmill synced to a 4-phase breathing cycle.
Designed for mindfulness and meditation on Meta Quest.
Built with Unity and C#.

Unblocked a Kotlin plugin stalled in production for two months by tracing 21 cascading issues.
Founded AuctionXI, live player-auction software for sports tournaments.
Real-time bidding, broadcast scenes and YouTube overlays, live at auction-xi.com.
Building a digital bahi-khata for textile brokers: bills, brokerage and follow-ups in one place.
Managed and optimized e-commerce operations across Amazon, TataCliQ and Sephora.
Owned listings, catalogue and day-to-day marketplace performance.
Improved a Shopify storefront through competitor analysis and UX changes.
First hands-on web role, shipped changes that sharpened the shopping flow.
